description.value: The Royal Anne Hotel is a historic boutique property in the heart of downtown Kelowna, tracing its origins to 1905 and rebuilt on the same Bernard Avenue site after a 1971 fire. It sits within steps of Okanagan Lake, City Park, and a wide range of restaurants, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the region. The nearby Kettle Valley Rail Trail is specifically called out by the hotel as a scenic cycling destination.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms this is a real, operating boutique hotel in downtown Kelowna. The amenities page explicitly lists 'Free Guest Laundry' and 'Complimentary High-Speed Wi-Fi', and O'Flannigan's Pub immediately behind the hotel provides confirmed nearby evening food. No mention of bike storage, bike rooms, e-bike charging, or any bike-specific staff procedure appears anywhere on the site, so those required criteria and several amenities remain null.
concerns: OSM lists only the local phone (+1-250-763-2277); the website also prominently displays a toll-free reservations line (1-888-811-3400) not captured in OSM.
Website notes a seasonal Bernard Avenue partial closure (May 12 – September 12, 2026) for 'MEET ME ON BERNARD' with traffic diversions that may affect cyclists approaching the hotel from the south.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating downtown hotel with an active website referencing summer 2026 events; useful stop for touring cyclists heading to or from the Kettle Valley Rail Trail.

Laundry.detail: Free guest laundry listed as a hotel amenity on both the amenities page and accommodations page

Nearby evening food.detail: O'Flannigan's Pub located off-site immediately behind the hotel, offering pub fare, appetizers, karaoke, live music, and comedy nights

wow_evidence: historic boutique property tracing its origins to 1905; Kettle Valley Rail Trail specifically called out as a cycling destination

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: historic boutique downtown Kelowna, affordable positioning; $140-190 shoulder
